decisions.reason: Because this product extends the firm's core wafer capabilities, fits its stated move toward more complex packaging substrates, and has already been publicly introduced, management would be inclined to continue backing it rather than reverse course after such recent investment.

Although its focus on smaller-diameter handling is somewhat less central to the firm's forward emphasis on thinner and larger-format substrates, it still builds directly on the established carrier-wafer business and recent commitments make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
